decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western side flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The demolition of an existing conservatory and erection of a new conservatory to the rear of the existing house, as shown on drawing numbers 582/01, received 24 October 2006; and 582/02A, received 18 December 2006, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the existing street scene and would satisfactorily maintain the appearance and character of the conservation area and the amenity of neighbouring properties, as it is to the same depth as the existing conservatory. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Demolition of the existing conservatory and erection of larger conservatory to the rear of the existing house.
